language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the picker, chat texts, commands and notifications. Auto follows the game language. The settings screen always uses the game language.

useGlobalSet.name: Global 7TV emotes
useGlobalSet.description: Load the global 7TV emote set (PogChamp, KEKW, ...).

popularEmotes.name: Popular 7TV emotes
popularEmotes.description: Also loads the most used emotes on 7TV (site wide). More emotes = more to browse in the picker.

extraEmoteSets.name: Extra emote sets
extraEmoteSets.description: Comma separated. Emote set IDs, 7tv.app/emote-sets/... links, 7tv.app/users/... links or twitch:<Twitch user id>.

animated.name: Animated emotes
animated.description: Play animated emotes. Off shows only the first frame and saves memory.

maxEmotesPerMessage.name: Max emotes per message
maxEmotesPerMessage.description: More tokens than this stay as plain text. Stops emote spam walls.

maxCachedEmotes.name: Texture cache size
maxCachedEmotes.description: How many emote images stay loaded. Older ones are freed automatically.

pickerKey.name: Emote picker key
pickerKey.description: Opens the emote picker while playing (not while chat is open). Default: V.

entries.send: Send it in chat right away

tabCompletion.name: TAB completion
tabCompletion.description: Type :po and press TAB in chat to complete the emote name. TAB again cycles.

filter.name: Content filter
filter.description: Sexual content is ALWAYS blocked. These control the remaining layers.

blockUnlisted.name: Block unlisted emotes
blockUnlisted.description: Unlisted emotes never went through 7TV moderation. Keep this on.

useBuiltInBlocklist.name: Built-in word list
useBuiltInBlocklist.description: Also blocks emotes whose name contains a word from the bundled NSFW list.

customBlocklist.name: Extra blocked words
customBlocklist.description: Comma separated. Emotes whose name contains one of these are hidden.

customAllowlist.name: Always allow (exact names)
customAllowlist.description: Comma separated emote names that bypass the word lists (never the flag checks).

picker.title: Emotify
picker.noEmotesLoaded: No emotes loaded yet. Check your internet connection or the emote sources in the settings.
picker.hint: Click an emote to insert it into chat  •  Enter picks the first match  •  Esc closes
picker.credit: Emotes and artwork © 7TV and their respective creators. Emotify is not affiliated with 7TV.

info.blocked: %s emotes hidden by the content filter:

command.disabled: Addon is disabled in the settings.
